nodes.label: BackendProgrammerCharacter
nodes.rationale: Dark-mode systems engineer rig (emerald LED studio headphones, rectangular glasses, >_ terminal hoodie) designed for API/DB/infrastructure tutorials, outage post-mortems, and Frontend vs Backend skits.

nodes.label: BossCharacter (Executive / Client Rig)
nodes.rationale: Executive rig with wide square jaw, silver temples, mustache, and charcoal suit for CEO/Client/Investor conflict triggers and business cost vs engineering trade-off explanations.

nodes.label: ChefCharacter (Culinary Analogy Rig)
nodes.rationale: Warm round-faced chef rig (toque hat, curved mustache, red scarf, apron, wooden spatula) built specifically for culinary analogies in coding and server architecture tutorials.

nodes.label: DoctorCharacter (Diagnostic Analogy Rig)
nodes.rationale: Calm, analytical doctor rig (slim longer face, oval glasses, white lab coat, 3D stethoscope) built for system checkup, debugging, and cybersecurity immunization analogies.

nodes.label: FrontendProgrammerCharacter
nodes.rationale: Creative, visually oriented UI developer rig (electric-cyan hair highlight, rounded-square glasses, </> sweater, cyan smartwatch) tailored for React/CSS/UI tutorials and client-side debugging sketches.

nodes.label: FullstackProgrammerCharacter
nodes.rationale: Dual-tone cyan/emerald character rig (wider energetic oval face, backwards cap, {</>} emblem) representing an end-to-end developer bridging Frontend, API, and Database workflows.

nodes.label: HackerCharacter (Cybersecurity / Pentester Rig)
nodes.rationale: Pointed V-shape face rig with raised matrix-green hoodie and 01 binary chest badge to depict ethical pentesters, attackers, and cybersecurity tutorials (SQLi, XSS, JWT/OAuth).

nodes.label: Hacker Character Props (hoodUp, showMask, showBadge)
nodes.rationale: Defaults showMask to false so lip-sync mouth animations stay visible during dialogue while allowing optional stealth mask coverage.

nodes.label: Interactive.create Studio Integration
nodes.rationale: Wraps character and property components with Interactive.create so props, placement, and keyframes can be manipulated visually inside Remotion Studio.

nodes.label: ManCharacter (Host / Friendly User Rig)
nodes.rationale: Foundational mascot rig (round glasses, swept black hair, blue tee, friendly round-oval face) cast as primary Host, beginner presenter, or curious everyday user.

nodes.label: Mascot/MascotRig, RigDemo & ModelSheet Compositions
nodes.rationale: Provides interactive playground, 18s demo, and model-sheet render compositions; avoids naming any composition 'Character' to prevent Windows CLI path collision with the character/ folder.

nodes.label: Standard Character Props Interface
nodes.rationale: Exposes expression/pose blending, talking/mouth lip-sync, motion cycles, 3D yaw/head angles, pupil lookX/lookY, framing, and deterministic seed (prevents synchronized blinking/talking when multiple characters share a frame).

nodes.label: ProjectManagerCharacter (Agile Coordinator Rig)
nodes.rationale: Diamond V-chin face rig (high ponytail, cat-eye glasses, terracotta blazer, office lanyard, smartwatch) portraying an Agile/Scrum coordinator mediating Boss scope changes and dev sprints.

nodes.label: QualityAssuranceCharacter (Bug-Hunter Rig)
nodes.rationale: Sharp slim-square face rig (bob hair, crimson cat-eye glasses, mustard vest, bug-and-checkmark badge) depicting a meticulous QA engineer blocking buggy Friday deploys and teaching E2E/unit testing.

nodes.label: character/shared Core Module
nodes.rationale: Centralizes shared 3D math, SkullShapeParams, IK/FK kinematics, 32 expression and 28 pose presets, motion cycles, facial/body SVG primitives, and Studio schema rendering for all 12 character rigs.

nodes.label: TechLeadCharacter (Senior Architect Rig)
nodes.rationale: Long slim angular face rig (under-eye fatigue lines, goatee, thin oval glasses, open olive flannel) representing a seasoned architect explaining system design, RCA, and simplicity over over-engineering.

nodes.label: WomanCharacter (Hijabi Mentor / Educator Rig)
nodes.rationale: Calm, intellectually authoritative rig (dusty rose hijab, gold brooch, teal tunic, soft oval face) cast as primary Coding Mentor, Fact-Checker, and logical team mediator with 100% props parity with ManCharacter.

nodes.label: MedicalKit
nodes.rationale: Visualizes first-aid kits and live ECG monitors (healthy/unhealthy states) for Doctor-led debugging and server health-check analogies.

nodes.label: OfficeDesk
nodes.rationale: Provides modern, executive, and minimal desk variants; setting showChair={false} avoids visual overlap when a character is positioned typing behind the desk.

nodes.label: ServingCloche
nodes.rationale: Visualizes burger, HTML, and JSON dishes under a cloche for Chef-led restaurant and API payload tutorial analogies.

nodes.label: FK/IK & Preset Customization
nodes.rationale: Enables custom PoseSpec via Forward Kinematics (lift, swing, bend, twist) or Inverse Kinematics (target, pole) and custom FaceSpec derived from EXPRESSIONS and POSES.

nodes.label: Master Character Rigs Catalog
nodes.rationale: Unifies 12 distinct 2D SVG cartoon character rigs behind a shared props interface (32 expressions, 28 poses, 24 mouth shapes, 5 motion cycles) exported via ../character for reusable multi-genre storytelling.

nodes.label: Reusable Character Properties Collection
nodes.rationale: Provides 12 2D vector props sharing a cohesive #1f1a1f bold-outline cel-shaded aesthetic, Studio Interactive.create support, and deterministic useCurrentFrame() animations compatible with all character rigs.

nodes.label: Remotion CLI Workflow
nodes.rationale: Standard npm and npx remotion commands for installing dependencies, running Studio preview (npm run dev), rendering videos (npx remotion render), and upgrading packages.

nodes.label: Remotion Company License
nodes.rationale: Notes that a company license is required for certain entities using Remotion.

nodes.label: Remotion Video Project
nodes.rationale: Root project README defining standard Remotion installation, Studio preview, video render, upgrade commands, documentation links, and company licensing terms.

nodes.label: Culinary Software Analogy Pattern
nodes.rationale: Translates SSR vs CSR, message queues, rate limiting, caching, load balancing, and server bottlenecks into relatable restaurant kitchen and order-serving scenarios.

nodes.label: Medical Diagnostic Software Analogy Pattern
nodes.rationale: Maps performance profiling, memory leak investigation, error log triage, firewalls, vulnerability patching, and malware quarantine to clinical symptom-diagnosis-prescription workflows.

nodes.label: Lip-Sync & Auto Lip-Flap System
nodes.rationale: Supports quick ~0.1s automatic mouth cycling via talking prop as well as frame-accurate phoneme mouth shapes (rest, mbp, aa, ee, oh, oo, fv, l, etc) and expressive mouths via Studio keyframes.

nodes.label: Rig Coordinate & Grounding System
nodes.rationale: Sets full framing to 840x900 px with feet at 95.6% height as default transform origin (so scale grows/shrinks from the shoes), 160 px head radius, ground at y=0, negative y upward, and [x, y, z] IK coordinates.

nodes.label: Single React Component Rig Pattern
nodes.rationale: Drives expressions, poses, facing yaw, blinking, talking, and locomotion via React props on one SVG rig rather than static image swaps so visual identity stays identical across every episode.

nodes.label: Walk & Run Anti-Slide Calibration
nodes.rationale: Matches in-place walk/run cycles to horizontal style.translate speeds of ~150 px/s * speed * scale (walk) and 310 px/s (run) so feet do not visually slide across the floor.

nodes.label: Reusable Character Casting Guide
nodes.rationale: Maps each character's facial posture, outfit, and persona to repeatable roles across Drama, Coding Tutorials, Analogies, Problem Solving, and Tech Fact formats.

nodes.label: Floor Alignment & Desk Pairing Pattern
nodes.rationale: Anchors characters (transformOrigin 420px 860px, typing hands y=-285) and OfficeDesk (transformOrigin 280px 340px, showChair=false) to a shared FLOOR_Y so desk legs, seated hands, and tabletop props (Y_LANTAI - 202 * deskScale) align across scales.
